what: The miniatures of MZ4250, one row per model, each a binary STL measured as a .bread file. Sizes in bytes, times in milliseconds.

credit.creator: MZ4250
credit.changes: Only measured: each STL was read, welded and written as .bread in memory. No model is redistributed.

machine: a desktop PC; models measured one at a time, write_file once, read_file the fastest of three
